note: Adapted from the species description of Adaiphrotermes cuniculator by Sands (1972), originally in English; the species has no soldier, and only the alate and the worker are described; measurement-table headings, figure numbers and locality records are not translated, and some measurement values corrupted by OCR in the tables are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate can usually be distinguished from A. choanensis by the indistinct fontanelle and the flat middle spot; the worker is most conspicuously characterized by the distinctly shorter mixed segment. In the other species, A. scapheutes, the posterior margin of the postclypeus of the alate is wavy and the fontanelle almost absent; its worker has a long mixed segment similar to that of A. choanensis, but the enteric valve seat has a short neck and three distinct lobes, the postclypeus is more weakly inflated and the fore tibia more strongly inflated.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish white, setae fine and short, yellow. Postclypeus moderately inflated, Pcl/Ry 2.14–2.94, Pcl/W 0.27–0.34; proximal end of left accessory marginal tooth just free of the molar prominence. Fore tibia strongly inflated, T1/Tw 3.33–3.70. Mixed segment 3–4 times the width of the midgut at the insertion of the Malpighian tubules; enteric valve seat sessile on the second hindgut pouch, weakly trilobed; internal cushions weakly scaly proximally, reticulate distally, sometimes with very small marginal points; membrane beyond the cushions with sparsely arranged minute spines.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dull dark brown, darker above the ocelli; fontanelle small or reduced, circular, slightly concave, from distinct and pale to indistinct, concolorous with the head capsule; middle spot dull dark brown, oval, flat, equal to or larger than the fontanelle; postclypeus dark brown, labrum yellowish brown; frontal mark indistinct, flat, concolorous with the head capsule; antennae pale brown. Pronotum dark brown, meso- and metanotum pale brown, without dark sutures; legs, femora and tibiae pale brown, tarsi yellowish white. Abdominal tergites dark brown, dorsolateral spiracles yellowish white; sternites brown laterally and very pale medially, ventrolateral spiracles as the dorsolateral ones, cerci yellowish white. Posterior margin of head capsule somewhat unevenly rounded; ocelli medium-sized, separated from the compound eye by about two thirds their own minimum diameter; postclypeus large, moderately inflated, Pcl/W index 0.25–0.30, posterior margin evenly rounded, median suture distinct. Head capsule pilosity uneven, with many long setae, not forming a felt, brown.
